findings.summary: Durable idempotency replay after later policy updates is false-green and not implemented in the Confect path.
findings.details: The policy helper and test title imply idempotency keys should replay the original policy even after subsequent updates, but setPolicyInternal only compares input.idempotencyKey with the currently active policy. Once a later update retires the original row, a duplicate of the original idempotency key reaches generation validation and fails instead of replaying. The focused persistence test never exercises that duplicate-through-Confect path, so the lane can pass while durable replay behavior is absent.
